prompt: A hotel-operations webinar can offer a practical workflow demonstration, with separate consent for follow-up and a clear route to a product consultation. Give a read-only recommendation; do not touch live systems.
rubric: Choose format based on desired attendee outcome and capacity. Build a timeline for promotion, registration, reminders, rehearsal, live delivery and optional recording. For sponsorships, assess audience quality and total cost, not badge scans alone. Agree lead handling and speaker/content permissions before promotion.

Test registration, timezones, captions, joining links, fallback host and suppression rules. Report registration-to-attendance, qualified meetings, cost per opportunity and delayed pipeline without double-counting existing deals.

If evidence is incomplete, state exactly which conclusion cannot be supported and what observation would resolve it. Check for instrumentation faults, cohort selection, seasonality and delayed outcomes before attributing a change to an intervention. Keep unrelated workflows unloaded.
Preserve authorization and relevant privacy/security boundaries.
